description.p: GitGud is a fast, native Git GUI built with Tauri and Angular. It provides an intuitive interface for managing Git repositories with branch visualization, commit history, staging area management, interactive rebase, diff viewer, and more.

ul.li: Visual branch and log graph
Side-by-side and inline diff viewer powered by Monaco Editor
Interactive staging and unstaging of changes
Push, pull, fetch, and remote management
Stash, tag, and branch operations
Transparent splash window while the app loads
Logo and repository name in the tab strip, main actions centered
Borderless window, browser-like tab strip as title bar
Offer a merge commit when dropping an ahead branch on a local branch
Hovering a file shows its path from the repo root
Keep a chip's icons on one line when its name is cut
Wait up to 2 s for another git process's index.lock
Continue, skip or abort a stopped cherry-pick, revert or merge
Name the sides of a revert conflict
Follow the selected commit when it vanishes
Wider, with a minimum width
Restart the interval when the delay setting changes
Cancel no longer submits the squash form
Show the LLM consoles open in each worktree
Switch worktrees within the repository's tab
Deploy a commit's pack of chips while a chip is dragged over it
Fade the commits of trees other than HEAD's
Draw a ground symbol under root commits
Shift the tip of a tree drawn right below another tree's root
Show the short commit after the version in the bonfire tooltip for non-release builds
Squash commits from the commit context menu, editing the resulting message in a dialog
Name the worktree locking a branch in the drag and drop menu
Grey out moving a branch checked out in another worktree
Cd into the repo before each command, so a worktree removed then added back at the same path still works
When git refuses to remove a worktree or delete its branch, show why and offer to force it with -f
Open the folder picker through the XDG portal
Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End works
Copy reference, relative reference and permalink did nothing on committed files
Show version over little bonfire
Show the background glow on load instead of on the first scroll
Pull and push say how many commits they move, offer rebase or merge when diverged
Group drop menu actions under the branch they update
Show how many commits each action moves in the drop menu
Sync version and download links on npm version, fix outdated text and screenshots
Offer fast-forward when dropping onto a remote branch, hide no-op rebase and push
Copy relative reference and permalink, open in editor and blame from the context menu
Copy a path:line reference from the context menu
Redo in text fields with ctrl+shift+z and ctrl+y
Ctrl+f focuses the search box and selects its text, even when already open
Show the full name of truncated branches, tags, stashes and worktrees on hover
Navigate between matches with arrows, Enter and Shift+Enter
Ship AppStream metainfo, license and icons in deb/rpm packages
Restart the fetch timer when the repo changes
Keep Home, End and arrow keys in the new branch name input instead of navigating the log
Pull a remote branch into its local branch from the context menu
Aggregate the selected commits into one card with a timeline
Context menu on a commit's files
Animate repository tabs while dragging
Show a loader on the update message button while rewording
Show days instead of hours when last fetch is over 24h ago
Undo the deletion of a remote branch or tag
Undo stash, branch and tag actions
Derive undo / redo from the reflog instead of toggling the last action
Save settings on modal blur (not only fields blur)
Download the package matching the installed format on Linux

description.p: Improved draw performance and multi-size desktop icons.
